arxiv-2103-13319.description: Abstract Fluoride crystals doped with rare-earth ions (REI) and pair centers in diamond for fast ( 10 − 9 ​ s 10^{-9}\rm{s} ) quantum computers (FQC) are proposed. As specific systems for REI doping, we propose C ​ a 1 − x ​ S ​ r x ​ F 2 Ca_{1-x}Sr_{x}F_{2} crystals and their analogues.

arxiv-2201-00080.title: PatchTrack: Multiple Object Tracking Using Frame Patches
arxiv-2201-00080.creator: Xiaotong Chen, Seyed Mehdi Iranmanesh, Kuo-Chin Lien
arxiv-2201-00080.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaotong Chen, Seyed Mehdi Iranmanesh, Kuo-Chin Lien. Object motion and object appearance are commonly used information in multiple object tracking (MOT) applications, either for associating detections across frames in tracking-by-detection methods or direct track predictions for joint-detection-and-tracking methods. However, not only are these two types of information often considered separately, but also they do not help optimize the usage of visual information from the current frame of interest directly.

arxiv-2205-03889.title: On preheating after inflation in scalar-tensor theories of gravity
arxiv-2205-03889.creator: Peeravit Koad, Jatechan Channuie, Phongpichit Channuie
arxiv-2205-03889.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the preheating mechanism after inflation in general scalar-tensor theories of gravity. In the present scenario, we consider two-field scenario and then derive the potential of exponential and hyperbolic tangent forms. We study the evolution of the background system when the back reaction on the background field is neglected.

arxiv-2209-12630.title: Lattice regularizations of θ \theta vacua: Anomalies and qubit models Preprint: IQuS@UW-21-031, INT-PUB-22-027
arxiv-2209-12630.creator: Mendel Nguyen, Hersh Singh
arxiv-2209-12630.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mendel Nguyen, Hersh Singh. Anomalies are a powerful way to gain insight into possible lattice regularizations of a quantum field theory. In this work, we argue that the continuum anomaly for a given symmetry can be matched by a manifestly-symmetric, local, lattice regularization in the same spacetime dimensionality only if (i) the symmetry action is offsite, or (ii) if the continuum anomaly is reproduced exactly on the lattice.

arxiv-2312-01033.title: Yang-Baxter Solutions from Categorical Augmented Racks
arxiv-2312-01033.creator: Masahico Saito, Emanuele Zappala
arxiv-2312-01033.description: Abstract . An augmented rack is a set with a self-distributive binary operation induced by a group action, and has been extensively used in knot theory. Solutions to the Yang-Baxter equation (YBE) have been also used for knots, since the discovery of the Jones polynomial.

arxiv-2405-01038.title: Evolution of multiple closed knotted curves in space
arxiv-2405-01038.creator: Miroslav Kolář, Daniel Ševčovič
arxiv-2405-01038.description: Abstract We investigate a system of geometric evolution equations describing a curvature and torsion driven motion of a family of 3D curves in the normal and binormal directions. We explore the direct Lagrangian approach for treating the geometric flow of such interacting curves.

arxiv-2405-02530.title: A study of newly discovered close binary open cluster candidates in the Milky Way from Gaia DR3
arxiv-2405-02530.creator: Zhongmu Li, Zhanpeng Zhu
arxiv-2405-02530.description: Abstract Context. With the release of Gaia data, the number of known Galactic open clusters (OCs) has increased rapidly, providing an excellent opportunity to confirm more binary open clusters in the Milky Way. Aims. Using a recently released OC catalogue, we employed the photometric and astrometric data of OCs and their member stars to find close binary open clusters (CBOCs).

arxiv-2506-06774.title: Mind Games! Exploring the Impact of Dark Patterns in Mixed Reality Scenarios Journal: PACMHCI Volume: 9 5 pn5758 9 DOI: 10.1145/3743709 CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in interaction design
arxiv-2506-06774.creator: Luca-Maxim Meinhardt, Simon Demharter, Michael Rietzler, Mark Colley, Thomas Eßmeyer, Enrico Rukzio
arxiv-2506-06774.description: Abstract . Mixed Reality (MR) integrates virtual objects with the real world, offering potential but raising concerns about misuse through dark patterns. This study explored the effects of four dark patterns, adapted from prior research, and applied to MR across three targets: places, products, and people.

arxiv-2511-15983.title: Descend or Rewind? Stochastic Gradient Descent Unlearning
arxiv-2511-15983.creator: Siqiao Mu, Diego Klabjan
arxiv-2511-15983.description: Abstract Machine unlearning algorithms aim to remove the impact of selected training data from a model without the computational expenses of retraining from scratch. Two such algorithms are “Descent-to-Delete” (D2D) and “Rewind-to-Delete” (R2D), full-batch gradient descent algorithms that are easy to implement and satisfy provable unlearning guarantees.

pmc-10621831.creator: Lok Hang Chan, Peihan Wang, Shatha Abuhammad, Lydia Rui Jia Lim, Joseph Cursons, Karen E. Sheppard, David L. Goode, Swati Palit Deb, Swati Palit Deb, Swati Palit Deb
pmc-10621831.description: Drugs targeting cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6 (CDK4/6) are promising new treatments for melanoma and other solid malignancies. In studies on CDK4/6 inhibitor resistance, protein arginine methyltransferase 5 (PRMT5) regulation of alternative splicing was shown to be an important downstream component of the CDK4/6 pathway.

pmc-12773356.title: Abstract 053: Reduced‐Dose Ticagrelor Versus Full‐Dose Ticagrelor Versus Clopidogrel In Acute Stroke Management: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12773356.creator: Harsh Desai, Ammar Tarabichi, Rami Morsi, Sachin Kothari, Julian Carrion‐Penagos, Okker Verhagen Metman, Matthew Smith, Archit Baskaran, Rohini Rana, Sonam Thind, Vanshika Narala, Sharanya Thodupunoori, Omar Vayani, Elisheva Coleman, James Brorson, Scott Mendelson, Ali Mansour, Shyam Prabhakran, Tar

This study compares the effectiveness of aspirin plus ticagrelor at different doses versus clopidogrel in reducing the risk of recurrent stroke and other thrombotic events without increasing the risk of bleeding.

pmc-13097398.title: Emotional and Behavioral Problems in Children and Adolescents: The Role of Parental Mental Illnesses: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13097398.creator: Mina Alekozay, Aziz‐ur‐Rahman Niazi, Abdul Fattah Najm
pmc-13097398.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and AimChildren and adolescents' emotional and behavioral problems pose considerable negative impacts on children's health and extend their influence into adulthood. Parental mental illnesses are prominent factors that may exacerbate these conditions. This study aimed to examine the prevalence of children and adolescents' emotional and behavioral problems and their association with parental depression and anxiety among children and adolescents residing in two districts of Herat city in 2023.MethodThis cross‐sectional study was conducted among schoolchildren (grades 5–12), between July and December 2023.

pmc-13268930.title: Electroacupuncture ameliorates embryo implantation dysfunction in mice via miR-30c-5p
pmc-13268930.creator: Jing-Yan Song, Feng-Yi Dong
pmc-13268930.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the intrinsic mechanism by which electroacupuncture (EA) treats embryo implantation dysfunction in mice from the perspective of exosomal miRNAs.MethodsHuman trophoblast cells (HTR-8/Svneo) were co-cultured in vitro with endometrial cells (Ishikawa and HEC-1-A), and exosomes derived from endometrial cells were isolated to treat HTR-8/Svneo cells. Cell proliferation and invasion were assessed by EdU staining and Transwell assays.

pmc-13291927.title: Cities at Sea: Coastal Urbanization Generates Local Biodiversity Hotspots but Homogenizes Marine Fish Communities Regionally
pmc-13291927.creator: Bastien Macé, Erwan Delrieu‐Trottin, David Mouillot, Alice Valentini, Morgane Bruno, Laure Velez, Amandine Avouac, Julie Deter, Thomas Bockel, Marie Orblin, Pierre Boissery, Gwénolé Le Roux, Stéphanie Manel
pmc-13291927.description: Urbanization is rapidly expanding along the world's coasts, transforming natural ecosystems into increasingly uniform artificial environments. Yet, the patterns and processes shaping marine biodiversity under urban pressure remain poorly understood. We investigated whether coastal urbanization drives marine communities toward greater similarity, a process well documented in terrestrial and freshwater systems as urban biotic homogenization but rarely examined in the sea.

pmc-13578097.title: The Terminator—A Blood Test for Early Detection of 50 Cancers
pmc-13578097.creator: Abraham Fessehaye Sium, Don Eliseo Lucero‐Prisno
pmc-13578097.description: Globally, cancer remains the second leading cause of premature death. Although there are existing cancer screening programs for early detection of some of the cancers, screening remains ineffective and at times difficult for the deadliest ones, as a result of which patients present in advanced stages with guarded prognoses.

pmc-13592970.title: An intelligent OCR-LLM prescription review system for inpatient narcotic and psychotropic drugs
pmc-13592970.creator: Rong Ma, Kai Xu, Mingming Zhang, Xiangpeng Li, Xingrong Ma, Junyu Wang, Jing Li
pmc-13592970.description: This study aimed to construct an intelligent prescription review system for inpatient narcotic and psychotropic drugs based on deep learning-based optical character recognition (OCR) and a local large language model (LLM) and evaluate its review performance and closed-loop management value. This study adopted a combined system development and retrospective validation design.
